overview_description.description: Array Labs designs and operates space-based radar systems and delivers 3D Earth imagery and geospatial data services. The company develops modular radar payloads and distributed radar satellite clusters that capture multi-angle data to generate detailed three-dimensional models of terrestrial surfaces and objects. It provides standalone radar instruments for integration on satellite platforms, fully integrated satellite systems for customers that require dedicated sensing assets, and processed 3D data products via APIs or delivery channels. Array Labs also works with partners to support simulation and modeling of distributed radar constellations and to co-develop enriched datasets that combine radar and other sensing modalities. Its offerings support applications such as geospatial intelligence, infrastructure monitoring, and analytical workflows reliant on volumetric surface data.

about_short_description.short_description: Array Labs designs and operates space-based radar systems and delivers 3D Earth imagery and geospatial data services.

product.name: Site3D
product.description: Site3D is an on-demand 3D imaging product that generates three-dimensional models of Earth's surface using synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and advanced mapping algorithms.

product.name: Distributed Radar Imaging System
product.description: A satellite-based imaging system using a cluster of radar cubesats to capture multiple-angle radar data simultaneously for high-resolution 3D imagery generation.

product.name: 3D Radar Imaging Algorithm
product.description: An algorithm that extracts 3D depth information from radar phase data within SAR imagery, enabling accurate 3D reconstruction with fewer satellite passes.
